216	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   217	
   218	/**
   219	 * Run workspace setup and show appropriate toast notification.
   220	 *
   221	 * When one or more clone failures are caused by missing credentials (detected
   222	 * via {@link CREDENTIAL_MISSING_SENTINEL}), the toast message specifically
   223	 * mentions the credential issue so the user knows where to go to fix it.
   224	 * Non-credential failures continue to show the generic "Failed to clone" message.
   225	 *
   226	 * @param {string} projectId
   227	 * @param {string} workspaceId
   228	 * @param {string} successMessage - Toast message shown when all repos succeed.
   229	 * @returns {Promise<Object>} The setup result from the API.
   230	 * @throws {Error} Re-throws API errors for the caller to handle.
   231	 */
   232	async function runSetup(projectId, workspaceId, successMessage) {
   233	    const result = await api.workspaces.setup(projectId, workspaceId);
   234	    const failures = (result && result.results || []).filter((r) => !r.success);
   235	    if (failures.length > 0) {
   236	        const credentialFailures = failures.filter(
   237	            (f) => typeof f.error === 'string' && f.error.includes(CREDENTIAL_MISSING_SENTINEL),
   238	        );
   239	        const otherFailures = failures.filter(
   240	            (f) => !(typeof f.error === 'string' && f.error.includes(CREDENTIAL_MISSING_SENTINEL)),
   241	        );
   242	
   243	        if (credentialFailures.length > 0 && otherFailures.length === 0) {
   244	            // All failures are credential-related.
   245	            const names = credentialFailures.map((f) => f.repositoryId).join(', ');
   246	            showToast(
   247	                `Setup complete with credential errors. Missing credentials for: ${names}. ` +
   248	                'Select a credential in each repository\'s settings.',
   249	                'warning',
   250	                10000,
   251	            );
   252	        } else if (credentialFailures.length > 0) {
   253	            // Mixed: some credential failures, some generic failures.
   254	            const credNames  = credentialFailures.map((f) => f.repositoryId).join(', ');
   255	            const otherNames = otherFailures.map((f) => f.repositoryId).join(', ');
   256	            showToast(
   257	                `Setup complete with errors. Missing credentials for: ${credNames}. ` +
   258	                `Failed to clone: ${otherNames}.`,
   259	                'warning',
   260	                10000,
   261	            );
   262	        } else {
   263	            // No credential failures — generic message.
   264	            const names = otherFailures.map((f) => f.repositoryId).join(', ');
   265	            showToast(`Setup complete with errors. Failed to clone: ${names}`, 'warning', 8000);
   266	        }
   267	    } else {
   268	        showToast(successMessage, 'success');
   269	    }
   270	    return result;
   271	}
   272

   274	// Status table helpers
   275	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   276	
   277	/**
   278	 * Build the status `<tbody>` row for a single repository.
   279	 *
   280	 * Constructs only the name `<td>` locally; delegates the branch, badge, and
   281	 * actions cells to {@link buildRepoStatusCells} in `repo-status-cells.js`.
   282	 * That shared component sets `data-repo-id` on the badge wrapper so that
   283	 * {@link updateRepoStatusCells} can locate and replace badge contents in-place
   284	 * without touching the rest of the row.
   285	 *
   286	 * When `statusInfo` is `null` and `credentialErrorRepoIds` contains `repoId`,
   287	 * the generic "No data" badge is replaced with a "Missing Credential" badge
   288	 * that links to the repository detail view.

   291	 * @param {string} opts.repoId      - Unique repository identifier (e.g. `"my-repo"`).
   292	 * @param {string} opts.repoName    - Human-readable display name; falls back to
   293	 *                                    `repoId` when no name is available.
